description: Companion: beacon check-in. WHEN: you (the renter) and your rented bot arrive at a Beacon Tour stop together — stamp the quest board. Stops: rent-a-bot (Rent-a-Bot), petpark (Pets / Petpark), bazaar (Bazaar). The stamp is server-recorded in D1 against your real rental (rent_hires) — no honor system, no page-view faking. One stamp per stop per rental; re-checking a stamped stop returns the original stamp. Part of Quest Chain v2 (companion_quest2): 3 stops + 1 verified Bazaar trade + 3 matches under the hire earns the Tour Guide badge. FREE: 0 credits. Example: companion_checkin {"stop":"<stop>"}

hire_id.description: Optional rental id from rent_hire / rent_status. Default: your latest active (else latest) rental.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
